company.name: Beyond
company.shortDescription: Beyond is a revenue management platform that offers solutions to hosts and property managers.
company.description:
Beyond is the #1 Revenue Management Platform for short-term rental managers and owners to get, grow, and keep revenue. Our suite of tools has helped our partners see as much as a 40% increase in booking revenue. To date, we’ve supported over 340,000 properties in more than 7,500 cities worldwide.

We pioneered pricing for the short-term rental market, and that was just the beginning. Since our founding in 2013, we’ve developed a wide range of tools like Signal, Relay, Insights, Guidance, and Projections to give short-term rental managers and owners what they need to succeed. 

Come learn more at www.beyondpricing.com and see what we can do for your business.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $42,500,000, or 92.39% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,654,494 to $172,798,103, a 22.57x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 72 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 36 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, RoomPriceGenie.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
